triggers.name: scheduled_report_batch
triggers.title: Scheduled report fetch
triggers.help: Runs a report on the specified schedule, returning results in batches. First provide the report URL, then provide any additional filters to narrow your results. Maximum size of each batch is 10000. Default size is 200

input.name: report_url
input.label: Report URL
input.hint: Enter the report URL found on the "View URLs Web Service" page in Workday. Note that URL params will have to provided separately in their own input fields below.

input.name: hour
input.label: Hour
input.hint: Hours in 24-hour format, i.e. 11 for 11am, 23 for 11pm. Defaults to 00 (12am) if left empty.

input.name: minute
input.label: Minute
input.hint: Minutes past the hour, i.e 00 for 0 minutes.

input.name: day_of_month
input.label: Day of month
input.hint: 1 - 31 , will be rounded down to last day of month for shorter months. Defaults to first day of the month if left empty.

input.name: format
input.label: Format
input.hint: Select the output format of the report. Default is CSV .

input.name: use_automatic_schema
input.label: Detect report schema automatically
input.hint: Set this to Yes or leave it empty to detect the report’s input and output schema automatically. Note that this does not work when the report URL contains a datapill.

input.name: remove_empty
input.label: Remove empty fields
input.hint: Defaults to Yes . Select No to retain the fields with Null value.

input.name: additional_fields
input.label: Additional fields
input.hint: Add any additional report fields that are not automatically generated in the output datatree.

input.name: replace_with_additional
input.label: Replace report fields
input.hint: If Yes, Additional fields will replace the original report fields with the same name.

input.name: report_batch_size
input.label: Report batch size
input.hint: Minimum size is 200 items, maximum is 10000.
